title: MetLife Certificate of Insurance — Dental Insurance for You and Your Dependents — North Carolina Office of State Human Resources, Group Policy 165756-1-G, Classic Option (OSHR title: 'MetLife Dental Classic Option Certificate (1/1/20)')
publisher: Metropolitan Life Insurance Company (MetLife); posted by North Carolina Office of State Human Resources
document_date_note: Face page: 'Certificate Date: January 1, 2020'. This certificate PREDATES the 2026 plan year by six years; two Certificate Riders effective 'January 1, 2024' amend it (recorded below). As of 2026-10-03 OSHR's documents page and Dental Plan Options page list no newer Classic certificate.

effective_period.quote_note: No end date; the certificate stays in force until replaced. 'Year or Yearly, for Dental Insurance, means the 12 month period that begins January 1.' (def 50)

scope.geography: North Carolina (State of North Carolina employees); a separate UNC Chapel Hill edition exists with the same date, policy number and schedule values
scope.population: Employees of the North Carolina Office of State Human Resources group policy (NCFlex) and their Dependents; 'Child ... is under age 26' (def 48)
scope.plan_type: Group dental insurance with In-Network (Preferred Dentist Program) and Out-of-Network benefits
scope.network: Preferred Dentist Program (In-Network Dentist 'participates in the Preferred Dentist Program', def 49); marketed in the 2026 guide as the 'MetLife Preferred Dental Provider (PDP) Plus Network'

retrieval_method: WebFetch (PDF->text). Page numbers are the printed footers 'GCERT2000 <section> <n>' (e.g. 'GCERT2000 sch 47', 'GCERT2000 def 50'); recorded as pdf_footer. Six targeted passes with quotes limited to ~125 characters each.
pages_note: Table of contents places GENERAL PROVISIONS at page 76, so the certificate has at least 76 printed pages; WebFetch's text conversion ends at footer 'e/ee 51' (ELIGIBILITY PROVISIONS: INSURANCE FOR YOU). Pages 1-2 face page, 3-46 state notices, 47 schedule, 48-50 definitions, 51 eligibility (reachable); 52-76+ NOT reachable.
reuse_terms: not stated in the reachable pages. Insurer form GCERT2000 ('fp as amended by GEND16-NM-DSC'); posted as a public document by a North Carolina state agency.
access_limits: WebFetch returned text only through footer 'GCERT2000 e/ee 51'. The following TOC sections were NOT reachable: DENTAL INSURANCE (p.59; would contain Deductible, Maximum Benefit, Alternate Benefits, Pre-Treatment Estimate and any Waiting Period clauses), DENTAL INSURANCE: DESCRIPTION OF COVERED SERVICES (p.63; Type A/B/C lists with frequency limits), DENTAL INSURANCE: EXCLUSIONS (p.66; missing-tooth and other exclusions), COORDINATION OF BENEFITS (p.68), FILING A CLAIM (p.73), PROCEDURES FOR DENTAL CLAIMS (p.74), GENERAL PROVISIONS (p.76). All facts that depend on those sections are UNKNOWN.

The UNC Chapel Hill edition (same URL family) was tried as an alternative; its text also ends early ('GCERT2000 50 e/ee', last sentence truncated mid-word: 'All Actively at Work University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill employees in a permanent, probati').
The answering model caps each quote at ~125 characters; long definitions were captured as consecutive pieces (R&C definition in 9 pieces).
'Negotiated Fee' was not found as a defined term in the reachable definitions (the in-network basis is defined as 'Maximum Allowed Charge').
